description: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is a financial services holding company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and one of the largest diversified financial institutions in the U.S., with businesses engaged in retail banking, corporate and institutional banking and asset management, providing many of its products and services nationally. It is organized around its customers and communities for strong relationships and local delivery of retail and business banking including a full range of lending products, specialized services for corporations and government entities, including corporate banking, real estate finance and asset-based lending, and wealth management and asset management. Its retail branch network is located coast-to-coast, and it also has strategic international offices in four countries outside the U.S., and at December 31, 2025 its consolidated total assets, total deposits and total shareholders' equity were $573.6 billion, $440.9 billion and $60.6 billion, respectively.
company_name: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc.
